headline: A learner can finally ask a question and see a complete source packet in one calm workspace.
copy: The default mode uses the bundled reviewed registry; local API mode is explicit and optional.

postures.title: Reviewed preview
postures.copy: Works on GitHub Pages with deterministic registry matching.

postures.title: Local API mode
postures.copy: Calls the private local Source API only when the user selects it.

postures.title: Source card
postures.copy: Citation, family, confidence, review state, rights state, and boundary stay together.

postures.title: No-source
postures.copy: Unsupported questions receive a clear limitation and next action.

postures.title: Memory
postures.copy: Questions and results are not stored or sent to telemetry.

flow.title: Ask
flow.copy: Enter one question or choose a sample.

flow.title: Match
flow.copy: Use the reviewed registry or selected local API.

flow.title: Read
flow.copy: Inspect citation, category, confidence, and boundary.

flow.title: Carry
flow.copy: Leave with one next action or an honest no-source state.

decisions.label: Default mode
decisions.reason: The public static site remains useful and honest without a server.

decisions.label: Optional mode
decisions.reason: Private demo users can exercise the backend spike.

decisions.label: Storage
decisions.reason: The demo keeps no question history.

decisions.label: Answer generation
decisions.reason: The demo shows source packets, not generated spiritual advice.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed translation or corpus delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness does not authorize public launch.
